nom: Bubble Morning Rays Brightening Eye Cream

avis.titre: My eyes are burning, I wish I hadn't spent the money
avis.texte: This product came highly recommended, so when I first used it and it caused my under eye and eyelids to burn, I thought maybe it was normal and my skin just needed to acclimate. I've used it 4 times now (only in the mornings) and the skin above my eyes is starting to peel and super irritated. I will no longer be using this product.

I'M OBSESSED. I have always felt the need to put concealer under my eyes due to dark under-eye bags. I could always tell a difference between my eyes when one side had concealer and the other didn't. After using this product regularly for a few weeks, I noticed there wasn't a big difference with concealer anymore. I've never used something that ACTUALLY worked like this has! I also love the feel of the serum.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I wanted to use this for 2 weeks before reviewing and here is what I found. It doesn't burn but there is a slight tingle upon application that quickly goes away. I have noticed a visible difference in the coloration around my eyes and am very happy with the results.

Such a great product. love the clean ingredient list and even after a night with too few hours with my eyes closed, when I use this my patients compliment how wide awake I look and how bright my eyes are. I work in Healthcare so not enough rest is a common complaint but you would never know from looking at my eyes! I've recommended to many people and am adding this to my cart again today...

Wow, this eye cream burns. And it burns intensely. I wanted to try this longer to see if it would help reduce my under eye circles but after trying twice, and having to remove the cream due to burns each time, I will just return the product. The one likeable thing about this product is the texture of the cream. It is thick but goes on smooth. The worst part, besides the burning sensation, is the pump; push down one time and you have more than enough cream for both eyes. It is so much that it feels wasteful. I have sensitive skin and most products with Vitamin C cause my skin to burn. If you have the same experience with Vitamin C, I would not recommend this product.

I don't think this significantly brigthened my undereyes at all. It is quite hydrating, and I liked the thicker texture. However, I did notice it ran out pretty quickly, and I am not a fan of the bulky packaging.
